title:
POV: I GAVE A HOMELESS MAN IN TEL AVIV
CLOTHES AND FOOD - THEN HE TOLD ME THIS
beats: local-ca1bb9b65735004c
'This is for you. Take off your shirt - we'll put a new one on you.'
local-19018606b6d6b0ee
[picture +2s, audio unchanged] 'What's your name?' 'Roman.' 'Where are you from?' 'Tel Aviv.' 'How old are you?' '33.'
local-e0275debb5700e8f
[picture -2s, audio unchanged] 'So here - we brought you some food.' 'Thank you. My brother, cheers.'
local-e0275debb5700e8f
'How long have you not eaten?' ... 'Two days you haven't eaten?'
local-3843b9158bfb6eb6
'Who do you miss the most?' ... 'My father.'
local-3843b9158bfb6eb6
[picture -12s, audio unchanged] as a kid he thought everything his father did was against him - he rebelled at all of it
local-3843b9158bfb6eb6
THE TURN: 'Only after he died ... you realise the man was only ever trying to guide you.'
local-530bd874ad57bc14

'So you need a home?' 'Not a home. A place to rest. One metre by one metre.'
